name: Hannah Tanaka
headline: Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Full-stack engineer who builds reliable web products across the stack and partners closely with product and operations teams. Experienced delivering customer-facing features, improving backend services, and shaping technical decisions for growing teams. Comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data stores, and modern interfaces.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Built responsive pages for the main product with HTML/CSS and JavaScript, and connected them to the frontend in Next.js.
Shipped cloud-hosted feature updates on AWS that reduced release defects by 20%.
Refined page interactions and layout behavior to improve task completion for 3 key user flows.
Collaborated with designers and engineers to keep the interface consistent while adding new screens in Next.js.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Delivered new backend endpoints in Node.js on AWS to support customer reporting tools used by 12 internal users.
Improved request handling and service reliability by simplifying the backend logic in Node.js.
Worked with product stakeholders to translate feature requests into practical application changes.
Supported ongoing releases by reviewing defects, testing fixes, and coordinating rollouts on AWS.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Designed service boundaries and shared data structures for customer workflows using GraphQL and PostgreSQL.
Built a searchable records experience in Vue backed by MongoDB, cutting lookup time by 35%.
Coordinated the backend and frontend implementation to keep the product stable during rapid changes.
Reviewed schema changes and application behavior to preserve consistency across the platform.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Architected new product services in Go and TypeScript across AWS and GCP, supporting a team of 8 engineers.
Built customer-facing dashboards in Vue and connected them to MySQL-backed workflows for daily operations.
Expanded end-to-end checks with Playwright, reducing escaped defects by 28%.
Shaped system design decisions for a growing platform and helped the team keep releases predictable.
Implemented automation around recurring business flows so support teams could complete tasks faster.

projects.name: Signal Scheduler
projects.description: Built a scheduling tool in Next.js and TypeScript with MongoDB to coordinate reminders and task timing for internal users.
